# Workbench operation tools

[Feature reference](../README.md)

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/workbench-tools.mjs. Run `make docs-tools` after an operation change. Do not edit by hand. -->

An agent of a Workbench session can call 107 KanthorD operations as tools. 45 of them change state and wait for the approval of the human. [How the native agent works](../../explanation/native-agent.md#tools) explains the selection rule and the exclusions.

The tool name is the operation id with each `.` replaced by `--`. A tool runs with the identity of the human who sent the last message.

| Service | Tools | Change state |
| ------- | ----- | ------------ |
| [Agent](#agent) | 10 | 6 |
| [Gateway](#gateway) | 2 | 0 |
| [LLM](#llm) | 10 | 4 |
| [Mission](#mission) | 40 | 20 |
| [Project](#project) | 13 | 3 |
| [Repository](#repository) | 8 | 3 |
| [Scheduler](#scheduler) | 4 | 0 |
| [Storage](#storage) | 7 | 3 |
| [Workbench](#workbench) | 8 | 5 |
| [Worker](#worker) | 5 | 1 |

## Agent

| Tool | Route | Approval | Description |
| ---- | ----- | -------- | ----------- |
| `agent--enablement--disable` | `POST /api/agent/enablement/:agentName/disable` | Yes | Disable an agent enablement without validating dependent bindings. |
| `agent--enablement--enable` | `POST /api/agent/enablement/:agentName/enable` | Yes | Validate and enable an existing agent enablement. |
| `agent--enablement--get` | `GET /api/agent/enablement/:agentName` | No | Get a live agent enablement. |
| `agent--enablement--list` | `GET /api/agent/enablement` | No | List agent enablements in ascending agent-name order. |
| `agent--enablement--provider--add` | `POST /api/agent/enablement/:agentName/provider` | Yes | Append a named provider to an agent enablement. |
| `agent--enablement--provider--model--list` | `GET /api/agent/enablement/:agentName/provider/:providerName/model` | No | List the models and reasoning efforts of one agent provider of an agent enablement. |
| `agent--enablement--provider--remove` | `DELETE /api/agent/enablement/:agentName/provider/:providerName` | Yes | Remove an unused named provider, retaining at least one provider. |
| `agent--enablement--put` | `PUT /api/agent/enablement/:agentName` | Yes | Create or replace an agent enablement at its expected revision. |
| `agent--enablement--remove` | `DELETE /api/agent/enablement/:agentName` | Yes | Remove an agent enablement with no dependent bindings. |
| `agent--get` | `GET /api/agent/:agentName` | No | Get an agent declaration and its current enablement. |

## Gateway

| Tool | Route | Approval | Description |
| ---- | ----- | -------- | ----------- |
| `gateway--healthcheck` | `GET /api/healthcheck` | No | Check resource health on demand, grouped by owner and scope. Returns every inventory entry with status and capability, including unknown for unfinished checks. A missing inventory returns 503 with missingInventories in error.details. |
| `gateway--verify` | `GET /api/auth/verify` | No | Verify the human bearer JWT and return its kind, sub and name claims without aliases, the token or token metadata. |

## LLM

| Tool | Route | Approval | Description |
| ---- | ----- | -------- | ----------- |
| `llm--credential--archive` | `POST /api/llm/credential/:credentialName/archive` | Yes | Archive an LLM credential that no dependent names. |
| `llm--credential--get` | `GET /api/llm/credential/:credentialName` | No | Get an LLM credential, all its revisions and the agent providers that name it. |

| `llm--credential--login` | `POST /api/llm/credential/login` | Yes | Start an OAuth credential login session. |
| `llm--credential--login_status` | `GET /api/llm/credential/login/:sessionId` | No | Read the state of an OAuth login session. |
| `llm--credential--platform_list` | `GET /api/llm/credential/platform` | No | List the LLM credential platforms. |
| `llm--credential--revoke` | `POST /api/llm/credential/:credentialName/revision/:revision/revoke` | Yes | End an older LLM credential revision. |
| `llm--credential--update_metadata` | `PUT /api/llm/credential/:credentialName/metadata` | Yes | Update LLM credential metadata in a new revision. |
| `llm--credential--verify` | `POST /api/llm/credential/:credentialName/verify` | No | Verify one stored llm credential record. |
| `llm--provider--check` | `POST /api/llm/provider/check` | No | Check the connection of an LLM credential through its LLM provider and read its model list when the check reads one. |

## Workbench

| Tool | Route | Approval | Description |
| ---- | ----- | -------- | ----------- |
| `workbench--session--abort` | `POST /api/workbench/session/:sessionId/abort` | Yes | Stop the active run of a workbench session. |
| `workbench--session--approve` | `POST /api/workbench/session/:sessionId/approve` | Yes | Approve or reject the pending call of a mutation tool of the active run. |
| `workbench--session--configure` | `PUT /api/workbench/session/:sessionId/configuration` | Yes | Replace the configuration of a workbench session. |
| `workbench--session--create` | `POST /api/workbench/session` | Yes | Create a workbench session with one agent of the catalog. |
| `workbench--session--events` | `GET /api/workbench/session/:sessionId/events` | No | Answer the session entries after `after` and the snapshot of the active run at once when `version` differs, else wait up to 25 seconds for a change. |
| `workbench--session--get` | `GET /api/workbench/session/:sessionId` | No | Get the configuration, the entries of the completed runs and the run state of a workbench session. |
| `workbench--session--list` | `GET /api/workbench/session` | No | List the workbench sessions of every agent, or of one agent. |
| `workbench--session--message` | `POST /api/workbench/session/:sessionId/message` | Yes | Start a run of the agent on one human message. A session holds one run at a time. |
